items.text: Alright, so when this merge conflict opens that, so when we are trying to merge it to May, if there is a conflict in it, open that particular branch with that particular command in VSCode, so that I can fix it from the VSCode or open the merge conflict UI from VSCode, whatever will be the best idea.
